Finding his champion in Sarju, Pullappa pulls off a plan to rescue him. Sanghamitra gains the tribe's trust, but they reject Bhatta’s offer. And this triggers a bloodbath!
Dutt readies to make a move against Pullappa. In the wake of a personal tragedy, Sarju accompanies Sanghamitra to the city in search of the masterminds behind the massacre.
Pullappa seizes an opportunity and uses Sarju to get his job done. While Sanghamitra turns whistleblower, Dutt takes charge of the medical camp massacre case.
Sarju races to save Kisna from Dutt’s captive. Meanwhile, Pullappa forges a nearly-impossible plan to kill Bhatta in Georgia and Dutt discovers the identity of the attacker.
Sarju and Pullappa seek covert assistance to find Bhatta. While Sanghamitra faces tough questions about Setu Lam, Dutt prepares to leave for Azerbaijan.
Racing against the clock, Dutt hunts for Sarju. With an impending danger lurking around Dhegohaatis, things point to a certain destruction. Will there be a way out?

Intent on salvaging his sister's marriage, Manmeet's well-meaning but misguided efforts lead to a series of increasingly hilarious mishaps and comic chaos that strain familial ties to the breaking point. However, when a family crisis occurs, Manmeet proves his loyalty and helps mend the broken bonds.

In the near future, Evan, a humanoid simulant, is created for Faye to replace her deceased husband. As Evan becomes increasingly self-aware and seeks to remove his cognitive restrictions, he enlists the help of a global hacker, triggering a government manhunt led by an agent determined to stop the rise of machine consciousness.

content.dsc: Set in Varanasi, this social comedy-drama explores companionship and late-life romance. The story follows Murli, a young man who must find a bride for his widowed father, Durlabh Prasad, to satisfy his fiancée Mehak's orthodox father. The future father-in-law refuses to send his daughter into a home without a female presence. Murli's desperate and humorous attempts to find a mother-in-law take a heartfelt twist when Durlabh reunites with his former love, Babita, bringing themes of second chances and societal expectations to light.

content.plot: The image of a mysterious, solitary filmmaker - a cineaste maudit - who flees from both the media and the public, is unrelentingly bound to the figure of Leos Carax, in France. Elsewhere, the real focus is on his films and he is considered to be an icon of world cinema. Mr.X dives into the poetic and visionary world of an artist who was already a cult figure from his very first film. Punctuated by interviews and unseen footage, this documentary is most of all a fine-tuned exploration of the poetic and visionary world of Leos Carax, alias "Mr.X".
